title: Beekman Social - Account Manager
description:
OPPORTUNITY: ACCOUNT MANAGER

Minimum 3 years of experience working in account management within a social, creative, or integrated agency
Freelance role, with possibilities of it becoming a Full Time position

BKMN is a fully remote agency

Hourly rate / compensation based on experience

Beekman Social is currently seeking a sharp, client-facing Account Manager to support key accounts on a freelance basis. This role will be instrumental in owning day-to-day client relationships and ensuring seamless execution across social-first creative work.

To be successful in this position, you must be highly organized, culturally fluent, and confident in fast-paced, client-facing environments. You understand how to balance creative ambition with operational rigor. You anticipate needs, bring solutions forward, and ensure both clients and internal teams feel supported, informed, and aligned.

Your experience makes you comfortable owning accounts from kickoff through delivery. You understand how social-first creative work comes to life. You are emotionally intelligent, proactive, and steady under pressure. In this role, you will help teams pursue the opposite of obvious, ensuring bold, culturally relevant work is delivered with precision and excellence.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are confident in owning day-to-day client communication and relationships.

  • You are highly organized and thrive in deadline-driven environments.

  • You are culturally fluent and trend-aware, with a strong understanding of social platforms.

  • You are solutions-oriented and anticipate challenges before they escalate.

  • You balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail.

  • You are emotionally intelligent and know how to manage client expectations with clarity and professionalism.

  • You execute independently with minimal oversight.

  • You are comfortable being in-person when needed for NYC-based shoots, events, or client touchpoints.

WHAT YOU’D DO

  • Own day-to-day client communication across assigned accounts.
    Lead client meetings, draft agendas, and manage follow-ups.

  • Manage client expectations with confidence and clarity.

  • Serve as a trusted partner on executional and operational needs.

  • Translate client goals into actionable project plans and workstreams.

  • Manage timelines, scopes, budgets (as applicable), and deliverables.

  • Coordinate approvals, feedback, and revisions across teams.

  • Proactively identify risks and course-correct when needed.

  • Partner closely with Creative and Strategy teams to deliver strong, social-first work.

  • Contribute to strategic conversations and content planning.

  • Ensure work is aligned with client business objectives and brand voice.

  • Lead internal teams to maintain momentum and clarity across projects.

  • Stay current on social trends, platform updates, and cultural moments.

  • Bring relevant insights into client conversations.

WHAT YOU’VE GOT

  • Minimum of 3  years of experience in account management at a social, creative, or integrated agency.

  • Proven experience owning client relationships independently.

  • Strong understanding of organic social and paid media campaigns.

  • Experience managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to manage complexity while maintaining composure.

  • Available for in-person moments, as needed.

 

If interested in this role, please send your resume over to Agnes@beekmansocial.com

title: Stack .NET Developer / Algorithm Engineer – Backend Focus.
description:
Stack .NET Developer / Algorithm Engineer – Backend Focus.

 

Remote

We are looking for an experienced  Full Stack .Net Developer, very strong on backend with some experience on F/E (react)to join our team and work on core components of a system designed to reduce healthcare costs through drug cost transparency at the point of care. This is a complex product featuring multiple integrations, APIs, a microservice architecture, and cloud-based infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data-driven and microservices architecture, algorithm thinking and use and extensive experience working with data. Additionally, they should have the ability and willingness to solve algorithmic challenges, and write clean, high-quality code while collaborating within a dynamic agile team.

This role requires flexibility, resilience, and the ability to adapt to changing priorities. We value independent thinkers, quick learners, and self-starters who thrive on solving problems in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements

Must 

  • Strong in Data Structure and Algorithm

  • Strong in Recursion

  • Strong understanding of OOP principles and design patterns

  • At least 6 years of experience Hands-on experience with .NET (C#/.Net Core 8+)

  • Experience with Entity Framework

  • Hands-on experience with Entity Framework

  • Proficiency in SQL

  • Analytical skills for solving challenges in complex systems

  • Some experience with microservices, RESTful services, API

  • Strong communication skills including the ability to reconcile competing business and technical viewpoints

  • A strong ability and willingness to solve algorithmic tasks

 

Nice to Have

  • Some experience with React

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (SDK)

  • Experience with NoSQL databases

  • Familiarity with message queue systems

  • Hands-on experience Hangfire and Redis

  • Experience with Docker

  • Extensive experience with data-driven architecture and working with data-intensive systems

  • Demonstrated experience designing and building cloud-based SaaS multi-tenant systems
